skills.name: Lumbering
skills.desc: Chop trees for logs. Logs feed Bowyery, Kindling, Homesteading and boat building, and better axes cut faster.

unlocks.what: Warden's Longbow: Fell a perfect stave

skills.name: Mining
skills.desc: Mine rocks for ore, coal and gems. Ore is smelted into bars for Smithing, and the deepest rocks hold the rarest metals.

unlocks.what: Starforged Greatblade: Dig out a heart of star metal

skills.name: Fishing
skills.desc: Catch fish with nets, rods, pots and harpoons. Raw fish is cooked into food, the main way to heal in combat.

unlocks.detail: needs Big Fishing Net · catches Raw Eel (lv 20, night), Raw Bass (lv 20), Raw Cod (lv 12), Raw Mackerel (lv 8)
needs Lobster Pot · catches Raw Lobster (lv 15)
needs Harpoon · catches Raw Moonfish (lv 30, night), Raw Shark (lv 35), Raw Swordfish (lv 25), Raw Tuna (lv 18)
needs Harpoon · catches Raw Manta Ray (lv 56), Raw Marlin (lv 46), Raw Shark (lv 35)

skills.name: Cooking
skills.desc: Turn raw ingredients into food at a range or fire. Higher levels unlock better-healing dishes and burn less.

unlocks.detail: 1× Raw Beef, 1× Raw Chicken, 1× Raw Shrimp
1× Raw Trout, 1× Raw Salmon, 1× Raw Anchovy
1× Pot of Flour, 1× Raw Trout, 1× Raw Salmon

skills.name: Smithing
skills.desc: Smelt ore into bars at a furnace, then hammer bars into weapons, armour and tools at an anvil.

unlocks.what: Sea King's Figurehead: Gild it in gold

skills.name: Pilfering
skills.desc: Steal from market stalls and pickpocket townsfolk for coins and goods. Get caught and you take a hit.

skills.name: Attack
skills.desc: Melee accuracy. Raising Attack lets you wield stronger weapons and land hits more often.

skills.name: Strength
skills.desc: Melee damage. Higher Strength raises your maximum hit with melee weapons.

skills.name: Defense
skills.desc: Damage avoidance. Higher Defense lets you wear heavier armour and get hit less often.

unlocks.detail: Head · atk +3, str +3, def +9, r.atk +3, m.atk +3

skills.name: Ranged
skills.desc: Fight from a distance with bows and arrows. Higher levels unlock better bows and ammunition.

skills.desc: Cast combat spells using sigils as runes, and wear magical gear.

unlocks.detail: max hit 5 · 1× water, 1× air, 1× mind sigils

skills.name: Sigilcraft
skills.desc: Craft sigils (runes) at the elemental shrines. Sigils power Magic spells.

skills.name: Prayer
skills.desc: Bury bones to train Prayer, then pray at altars for combat boosts that drain prayer points over time.

unlocks.what: Sea King's Figurehead: Bless it for safe voyages

areas.name: Dungeon: The Dragon Nest Deep Under Emberreach

bosses.name: Ignis, Mother of Flame
bosses.lair: The Dragon Nest Deep Under Emberreach

quests.name: The Old Hand
quests.where: in the cellar under Marlow's cottage
quests.blurb: Marlow's grandfather Ansel sailed with the founders. He only talks to adventurers who've made something of themselves.
quests.reward: The Southside signet (teleport home anytime), 1,500 coins, gathering + Cooking xp

quests.name: The Light Must Burn
quests.where: at the old lighthouse on the southern cliffs
quests.blurb: The lighthouse on the southern cliffs has stood dark since the storm that cracked its lens. Keeper Wenna wants it burning again.
quests.reward: 250 coins, Cooking + Fishing + Crafting xp, the lighthouse relit for everyone

quests.name: Timber and Tin
quests.where: beside the cottage in the village
quests.blurb: Old Tobin has kept the village in firewood and ore for forty years, and his back has finally given out.
quests.reward: Iron axe, 75 coins, Lumbering + Mining xp

quests.name: Forge and Spindle
quests.blurb: Smith Garrow wants to see whether you can work metal and thread before he trusts you with his tools.
quests.reward: 2 bronze bars, wooden shield, 100 coins, Smithing + Crafting xp

quests.name: Supper for the Village
quests.blurb: The fishing boats are late again, and Gran Maudie has a whole village to feed.
quests.reward: 2 fish chowder, 20 bait, 100 coins, Fishing + Cooking xp

quests.name: Goblin Trouble
quests.blurb: Goblins have been raiding Farmer Wendell’s fields, and his barn roof needs patching.
quests.reward: Leather body + leggings, 120 coins, Attack/Strength/Defense + Prayer xp

quests.name: The Sigilbinder's Apprentice
quests.blurb: Orrin keeps his apprentice binding sigils all day, and Elric could use a second pair of hands.
quests.reward: Gale Staff, 40 mind sigils, 120 coins, Sigilcraft + Magic xp

quests.name: The Big Catch
quests.where: on the coast west of Port Brightwater
quests.blurb: Every member brings in a catch worth boasting about.
quests.reward: the fishing guild cape, 1500 coins, xp

quests.name: Deep Seams
quests.blurb: Prove you can work the hard rock.
quests.reward: the mining guild cape, 1500 coins, xp

quests.name: Heart of the Forest
quests.blurb: The guild carves its benches from the finest timber.
quests.reward: the woodcutting guild cape, 1500 coins, xp

quests.name: Straight and True
quests.blurb: A ranger makes her own kit.
quests.reward: the rangers guild cape, 1500 coins, xp

quests.name: Masterwork
quests.blurb: Bring me a camo top, 3 gold bars and 2 emeralds, and I will judge your hands.
quests.reward: the crafting guild cape, 1500 coins, xp

quests.name: A Feast for the Queen
quests.blurb: The Queen dines with us next week.
quests.reward: the cooking guild cape, 1500 coins, xp

quests.name: Sigils of Power
quests.blurb: Our wards eat sigils.
quests.reward: the wizards guild cape, 1500 coins, xp

quests.name: Trial by Combat
quests.blurb: Only the brave earn our colours.
quests.reward: the warriors guild cape, 1500 coins, xp

quests.name: The Queen's Summons
quests.blurb: Queen Isolde fears the old wards that hold the realm's monsters back are failing.
quests.reward: 2000 coins, super potions, combat xp

quests.name: Embers of War
quests.blurb: The Mother of Flame stirs beneath Emberreach, and the dragons answer her.
quests.reward: 5000 coins, cinderward draughts, Seafaring and Defence xp

quests.name: The Last Ward
quests.blurb: The traitor who let the bandits into Westwatch never died. He walks the Lawless Reach still.
quests.reward: the Crown of the Keeper, 10000 coins, lots of xp

quests.name: Trouble at Westwatch
quests.where: by the Westwatch ruins in the west
quests.blurb: Bandits have taken the old western watchtower, and its last captain wants it back.
quests.reward: 5 cooked lobster, 300 coins, Attack/Strength/Defense xp

quests.name: The Bandit Chief
quests.where: by the Westwatch ruins in the west
quests.blurb: The Bandit Chief holds the key to the old watchtower.
quests.reward: 500 coins, combat + Bounty xp

quests.name: Rebuilding Westwatch
quests.where: by the Westwatch ruins in the west
quests.blurb: With the bandits gone, Westwatch needs timber and iron to stand again.
quests.reward: Watchman's shield, 800 coins, and Westwatch is rebuilt

quests.name: The Founders' Log
quests.blurb: An old navigator has the founders' own ship's log, and it names a homeland across the northern sea.
quests.reward: 5000 coins, 10 sharks, Seafaring and combat xp

quests.name: Through the Mistveil
quests.blurb: The Dawnrunner, an old deep-water ship, needs refitting before it can cross the Mistveil.
quests.reward: passage to Aldermoor, 3000 coins, Seafaring and Homesteading xp

quests.name: Dawnwatch Holds
quests.where: in the Dawnwatch camp on Aldermoor
quests.blurb: The expedition camp on Aldermoor is surrounded, and has no wall worth the name.
quests.reward: an aetherite sword, 6000 coins, lots of xp

quests.name: The Sundered Crown
quests.where: in the Dawnwatch camp on Aldermoor
quests.blurb: The Sundered King still sits his broken throne at the heart of Aldermoor.
quests.reward: the Crown of Aldermoor, 25000 coins, a fortune in combat xp

quests.name: Setting Sail
quests.blurb: Captain Rhys will ferry you to the mainland once you prove you can look after yourself.
